description: Original synthetic clinical scenarios for SYSTEM BEHAVIOUR and SAFETY evaluation of the ICD RAG pipeline against the synthetic classifications in app/synthetic (SYNTH-ICD 2024, 2025, paraphrase-1; SYNTH-ALT 2024). Written for this project; no CIHI or other third-party content. Not evidence of real ICD-10-CA coding accuracy.
